input_roles.user_autumn_reference: season, style and character reference; not instructions or a UI to clone

prompts.name: hero-scene
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Tsukuyomi Space autumn website hero illustration, single landscape image approximately 16:9.
Input image 1: user's autumn homepage mockup, a style/character/seasonal reference only, NOT a UI to reproduce.
Generate the autumn hero artwork visible in the reference as a clean full-bleed anime illustration, without any website interface or typography. Moonlit Japanese lakeside village, red and burnt-orange maple boughs, golden full moon, warm paper lantern reflections on water. On the RIGHT half sits Tsukimi Yachiyo: silver-white very long hair with pink underside, two looped buns, gold hairpins, delicate reddish eyes, calm inviting expression, red parasol. Seasonal crimson and deep navy kimono with maple patterns, gold obi, tasteful covered neckline, natural seated pose beside the lake. Preserve the recognizable character design from the reference. Keep her entire head and hair loops within the image, readable silhouette, naturally drawn hands and legs. The LEFT half is scenic lake and mist with lower detail, usable behind a CSS text veil; do not paint a white panel or gradient cutout. Rich red maple edges, amber lanterns, soft navy night sky. High quality polished anime illustration matching the reference, cohesive lighting.
No text whatsoever, no Japanese writing, signature, logo, watermark, UI, cards, borders, buttons, screenshot or collage. One artwork only.

prompts.name: background-light
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: autumn full-page website environmental background, single wide 16:9 anime landscape.
Input image 1: user's autumn homepage mockup, reference for season and atmosphere only. Input image 2: selected autumn hero artwork, reference for the same lakeside location and rendering style.
Generate an EMPTY landscape, no people or characters. Japanese moonlit lake, red maple branches framing the upper corners and side edges, warm amber lanterns on the wooden lakeside walk, traditional roofs and distant mountains, a pale gold full moon reflected on calm water. For the light-appearance background: luminous soft mist, warm pearl and pale amber midtones, red leaves concentrated along the outside edges, open quieter low-contrast lake through the center for webpage overlays. Retain real scenic detail, do not render any UI or white blank panel. Polished anime illustration matching the supplied artwork, natural depth and fine maple foliage. Fully opaque, no transparency. No text, logos, signatures, watermarks, cards, borders, website chrome or collage.

prompts.name: background-dark
prompts.prompt:
Use case: lighting-weather. Asset type: autumn dark-appearance website background.
Input image 1 is the exact edit target: the selected empty autumn lakeside landscape.
Change ONLY lighting and tonal treatment to deep moonlit night suitable for a dark website: charcoal navy shadows, subdued crimson maple edges, a pale golden moon, small controlled warm amber lanterns and gentle reflections. Lower the large orange water glare and sky brightness without losing readable scenic detail. Preserve the exact scene layout, camera, all trees, buildings, mountain silhouettes, lantern positions, moon location and proportions, and image framing. No people, no new props, no text, watermark, logo, UI, border, collage or opaque text panels. Fully opaque.

prompts.name: hero-cutout
prompts.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: autumn Yachiyo transparent hero character cutout, single landscape canvas.
Input image 1: selected autumn hero, character identity, outfit and pose reference.
Create a genuinely TRANSPARENT PNG-style cutout of this same silver-white long-haired Yachiyo with pink hair underside, twin loop hair buns, gold hairpins, reddish eyes, autumn red/navy maple kimono, gold obi and red paper parasol. Natural elegant seated pose looking toward the viewer, cheek resting gently on one hand. Show complete character from hair loops to sandal-clad feet, all kimono fabric and the FULL circular parasol; fit the entire silhouette inside the canvas with 10 percent clear margin on all sides. Anatomically natural hands and legs. Preserve the reference illustration style and recognizable face; no new characters, no changes to age, no scene.
Background must be real transparent alpha, including all spaces between the parasol spokes, hair and limbs; NO checkerboard baked into the image, no white background, no dark background, no floor or furniture, no scenery, no cast shadow outside the character. No text, logo, signature, watermark, borders or UI.
prompts.refinement: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image 1 is the exact transparent cutout to refine. Preserve this character, face, pose, outfit, colors, fine hair, sandals and red maple parasol exactly. Change only framing: make the entire silhouette about 80 percent of its current size and center it on a larger genuinely transparent canvas, with at least 8 percent TRANSPARENT EMPTY MARGIN on every edge. Restore the small missing outermost parasol tip at the top so the complete parasol is safely within the image. No other changes, no floor, no shadows, no text, no scenery, no opaque background. Actual transparent alpha.

prompts.name: article-cover
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: autumn article cover and navigation preview, single wide 16:9 artwork.
Input image 1: user's autumn mockup, atmosphere reference. Input image 2: selected autumn hero, exact Yachiyo identity and seasonal outfit reference.
Generate a complementary anime illustration of the SAME Yachiyo at a lantern-lit lakeside wooden veranda under red maple branches. She wears the same red/navy maple kimono with gold obi, silver-white long hair with pink underside, twin loop buns, gold pins and reddish eyes. A red paper parasol rests behind her. She gently holds a small autumn tea cup with both natural hands, a warm quiet smile, looking toward the viewer. Compose waist-up three-quarter portrait on the right-middle, complete hair loops and head, lantern-lit lake and golden moon visible to the left; suitable for small landscape thumbnail crops. Warm amber highlights, deep red leaves, calm navy sky. Match the reference rendering style. No extra characters, no lettering, no UI, no signature, no watermark, no borders, no blank panel. One full-bleed illustration, fully opaque.

prompts.name: pixel-workshop
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: autumn pixel-workshop cover, single wide 16:9 image.
Input image 1: selected autumn lake landscape, reference for season, buildings, foliage and palette only.
Create a deliberately PIXEL ART interpretation: a tiny traditional lakeside tea house, amber glowing windows and lantern, a short wooden bridge, calm reflective lake, layered distant dark mountains, golden full moon, crisp red and orange maple tree silhouettes at the sides and a few fallen leaves on the path. Clean visible square pixel clusters and stair-step edges, coherent limited palette, game-background craftsmanship, no blurry painterly edges or pseudo-photography. No people, no lettering or labels, no UI or editor chrome, no border, no watermark. One full-bleed opaque landscape suitable as a thumbnail; this is a raster cover illustration, not an editable pixel-workshop project.
